mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO dm_change_trigger_receipt( gmt_create, gmt_modified, owner_uid, ref_flow_id, provider, delivery_id, commit_id, trigger_type ) VALUES ( NOW(), NOW(), #{receipt.ownerUid}, #{receipt.refFlowId}, #{receipt.provider}, #{receipt.deliveryId}, #{receipt.commitId}, #{receipt.triggerType} )
mapper.select: SELECT receipt.id FROM dm_change_trigger_receipt receipt LEFT JOIN dm_change_flow flow ON flow.id = receipt.ref_flow_id AND flow.owner_uid = receipt.owner_uid WHERE flow.id IS NULL ORDER BY receipt.id LIMIT #{batchSize}
